summary.text: Al Muratsuchi is a Democratic member of the California State Assembly representing District 66; he assumed office in 2016, and his current term ends on December 7, 2026.

paragraphs.text: He previously represented District 66 in the Assembly from 2012 to 2014.
He earned a B.S. from the University of California, Berkeley, and a J.D. from UCLA.
Ballotpedia reports that he is not running for re-election to the Assembly in 2026 and lost the June 2, 2026 primary for California Superintendent of Public Instruction.
